name: Zhejiang Jingsheng Mechanical & Electrical Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Jingsheng Mechanical & Electrical Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of semiconductor equipment, semiconductor substrate materials, consumables, and components in China and internationally. It offers advanced equipment, such as power semiconductors and advanced process equipment, and photovoltaic equipment, as well as semiconductor materials and equipment; and advanced materials, including diamond, sapphire, quartz crucible, diamond wire, and graphite products and silicon carbide components.
